$keywords: brand tokens, design tokens, DTCG, token template, brand primary, on-primary, accent, surface, on-surface, muted, brand font, display font, body font, radius, oklch, tokens de marca
$summary: Design Tokens Community Group template for the nine shared brand tokens; copy it into the project and fill it during brand intake or after a confirmed no-brand proposal.

brand.$description: Shared brand tokens. The token path maps to a CSS custom property: brand.primary becomes --brand-primary. Copy this file into the project; never edit the skill's template. Every placeholder color is the same gray, so an unfilled token fails every contrast check. When you fill a value, set $extensions.kinetic-ui.origin to given, derived, assumed, or proposed.

primary.$description: CSS variable --brand-primary. Main brand color for primary actions and key highlights. Keep the exact given value; derived steps never replace it.

on-primary.$description: CSS variable --brand-on-primary. Text and icons placed on --brand-primary; must reach 4.5:1 against it.

accent.$description: CSS variable --brand-accent. One secondary color for highlights, focus, and signature effects; 3:1 on --brand-surface for graphics, 4.5:1 when it carries text.

surface.$description: CSS variable --brand-surface. Page and container background.

on-surface.$description: CSS variable --brand-on-surface. Main text and icon color on --brand-surface; must reach 4.5:1 (aim for 7:1 for long reading).

muted.$description: CSS variable --brand-muted. Low-emphasis color for secondary text, captions, and dividers on --brand-surface; 4.5:1 when it carries text.

font-display.$description: CSS variable --brand-font-display. Headline family first, then a metric-close fallback and a generic family. Verify the web license.

font-body.$description: CSS variable --brand-font-body. Body and UI family; may equal the display family. Verify the web license and language coverage.

radius.$description: CSS variable --brand-radius. Corner radius of interactive components (buttons, inputs, cards). Placeholder 0px; take the value from the brand design system or the chosen style.
